basis: Mature lymphoid leukemia occupying peripheral blood, marrow and spleen; no common additional organ damage established.
Hypohidrosis, palmoplantar keratoderma, enamel hypoplasia and intellectual disability define the syndrome; hepatitis is occasional.
Limb webbing/contractures, ectodermal defects and oral synechiae define disease; corneal ulceration reported in 4/4 supports ocular damage.
Meningioma originating in the cerebral convexity meninges.
Defined by increased circulating platelets; thrombosis is neither universal nor intrinsic across this umbrella.
Benign fibroepithelial neoplasm arising in the kidney; possible polycythemia does not establish common intrinsic blood disease.
Metabolic disease with neutropenia and neutrophil immunodeficiency; hepatic glycogen accumulation 80-99%. Enterocolitis and bone loss also frequent, omitted at cap.
Inflammation of the stomach and duodenum; no specific infectious or immune-mediated cause is inherent in this umbrella.
Corpus callosum agenesis and congenital lymphatic vascular dysfunction are the defining abnormalities; lymphedema maps to the vascular axis.
Neutrophil abnormality with immunodeficiency/autoinflammation; recurrent aphthous stomatitis in 3/3. Skin abscesses/paronychia are secondary infections.
Mitochondrial respiratory-chain metabolic deficiency localized to skeletal muscle.
Oligodendroglial tumor arising in the brain.
Ciliary disorder with chronic sinusitis in 3/3 and recurrent middle-ear disease in 2/2. Situs inversus/dextrocardia alone do not establish cardiac injury.
Pyrimidine catabolism defect; seizures, intellectual disability and developmental delay occur in 30-79%. Reduced hepatic enzyme activity alone is not liver damage.
Defined by congenital restrictive ophthalmoplegia/extraocular muscle fibrosis together with ulnar hand and carpal malformations.
Agammaglobulinemia, neurodevelopmental impairment and severe dermatitis define disease; craniosynostosis 30-79%. Frequent cleft palate/choanal stenosis omitted at cap.
Inflammation of ethmoid sinus mucosa, an upper-airway site; the umbrella definition does not establish a specific infectious or immune mechanism.
Lower motor neuron/anterior horn disease; limb weakness and wasting reflect denervation rather than a separate intrinsic skeletal-muscle process.
Papillary neoplasm originating in the renal pelvis.
Nonsyndromic progressive hearing impairment caused by SERPINB6 mutations.
Striatal neurodegeneration causes the movement disorder; dysphagia is neurologic dysfunction without established intrinsic gastrointestinal damage.
Defined by absent pulmonary valve, ventricular septal defect and persistent ductus arteriosus; pulmonary valve is a cardiac structure.
Muscular dystrophy with contractures and characteristic cardiac conduction disease/cardiomyopathy; cardiac findings occur in 30-79% and are major diagnostic features.
Thymic epithelial tumor has no applicable anatomical axis; it is not lymphoma. Associated myasthenia gravis and red-cell aplasia are separate diseases.
Milk-induced pulmonary hypersensitivity with hemosiderosis and characteristic anemia; digestive bleeding qualifies as a defining manifestation.
